title: The rescaled function R₀⁻¹w(R₀·) satisfies the unit-scale hypotheses (steps B1–B2)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, δ ∈ ℝ, R₀ > 0, and let w : ℝⁿ → ℝ (ℝⁿ = Euclid n) be Lipschitz with constant Lw, with ∫_{B_{R₀}} ‖Dw‖² ≤ R₀ⁿ, and such that |∫_{B_{R₀}} Σ_{i<n} Dw(v)e_i·Dζ(v)e_i dv| ≤ δ·R₀ⁿ·G for every C¹ function ζ : ℝⁿ → ℝ with compact support and tsupport ζ ⊆ B_{R₀} and every G ∈ ℝ with ‖Dζ(v)‖ ≤ G for all v (B_ρ := B̆_ρ(0), D := fderiv ℝ, e_i := EuclideanSpace.single i 1). Put w₁(y) := R₀⁻¹·w(R₀·y). Then (a) w₁ is Lipschitz with the same constant Lw; (b) ∫_{B_1} ‖Dw₁‖² ≤ 1; (c) |∫_{B_1} Σ_{i<n} Dw₁(v)e_i·Dζ₁(v)e_i dv| ≤ δ·G for every C¹ function ζ₁ : ℝⁿ → ℝ with compact support and tsupport ζ₁ ⊆ B_1 and every G ∈ ℝ with ‖Dζ₁(v)‖ ≤ G for all v.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (δ R₀ : ℝ) (w : Euclid n → ℝ) (Lw : NNReal), 0 < R₀ → LipschitzWith Lw w → ∫ v in ball (0 : Euclid n) R₀, ‖fderiv ℝ w v‖ ^ 2 ≤ R₀ ^ n → (∀ ζ : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) R₀ → ∀ G : ℝ, (∀ v, ‖fderiv ℝ ζ v‖ ≤ G) → |∫ v in ball (0 : Euclid n) R₀, ∑ i : Fin n, fderiv ℝ w v (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) * fderiv ℝ ζ v (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))| ≤ δ * R₀ ^ n * G) → LipschitzWith Lw (fun y : Euclid n => R₀⁻¹ * w (R₀ • y)) ∧ ∫ v in ball (0 : Euclid n) 1, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y : Euclid n => R₀⁻¹ * w (R₀ • y)) v‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ ζ : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) 1 → ∀ G : ℝ, (∀ v, ‖fderiv ℝ ζ v‖ ≤ G) → |∫ v in ball (0 : Euclid n) 1, ∑ i : Fin n, fderiv ℝ (fun y : Euclid n => R₀⁻¹ * w (R₀ • y)) v (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) * fderiv ℝ ζ v (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))| ≤ δ * G
